objective: Re-run RC-D's UNMODIFIED keyed 16-round Feistel oracle (verbatim source, zero code changes) under a second preregistered seed S2=531002 at matched decisive exposure 2^30, against a freshly recomputed live 5-round AES arm under the same new seed, to test whether the BATCH-014 absence of yoyo excess under this substitute is one-key or holds across keys -- the second of EV-AES-dec938's named U4 confounds ('other keys/seeds').
headline: OUTCOME (a) REALIZED: THE ABSENCE PERSISTS AT S2. Under seed 531002 (key 58146703b42fca722bc0ab918cd1409b) the recomputed live r=5 AES arm read 19 hits against an analytic null of ~1 (R_aes=19.0, Garwood 95% CI [11.44, 29.67] -- the excess reproduces under the new key, stronger than the 14 at 531001), while RC-D's verbatim 16-round Feistel substitute read 0 hits at the same matched exposure (R_F=0.0, Garwood 95% CI [0, 3.689], containing 1). Frozen matched-exposure comparator: exact conditional-binomial p=3.814697e-06 (n=19, exposure-weighted p0=1073741823/2147483647~0.5), rate-ratio CI lower bound 4.667. The RC-D pattern (AES elevated, substitute at its own null) reproduces on a second key of the identical construction.
plain_statement_first_line: OUTCOME (a): absence of the yoyo excess under this Feistel substitute persists at the second preregistered seed/key 531002; the excess is NOT key-specific to 531001 in the direction this task tests.

frozen_comparator_context.note: The frozen comparator READING of record remains BATCH-009's P1-R5-PAIR (seed 531001), used here only as a secondary cross-anchor; at S2 the trial stream is seed-dependent, so the decision-driving comparator seat is the live AES arm recomputed under S2 (this is precisely why the AES arm could not be reused from any archive).

plain_statement: At the second preregistered seed/key 531002, RC-D's verbatim 16-round Feistel substitute again reads at its own analytic null (0 hits at 2^30, R=0, CI [0, 3.69] containing 1) while the freshly recomputed matched live r=5 AES arm under the same new key reads elevated (19 hits against ~1 expected). The frozen matched-exposure comparator rejects equal rates at p=3.8e-6 with the substitute's rate-ratio CI bounded below by 4.67. The BATCH-014 absence of yoyo excess under this substitution therefore holds across two keys of the identical construction; the outcome is (a), absence persists. This narrows EV-AES-dec938's U4 'other keys/seeds' confound for this one construction by one additional key; it does not resolve U4 for other constructions, round counts, or geometries, and per the task's prohibitions this record assigns no evidence strength, no hypothesis status, and recommends no promotion.
unexpected_observations: The S2 live AES arm read 19 hits, a higher count than 531001's frozen 14 at the same exposure and geometry (R_aes 19.0 vs 14.0; both far above the ~1 analytic null). Recorded per rule 8 as an observation that the r=5 excess is not only present but quantitatively variable across keys; no interpretation beyond the arithmetic is attached here.

F16-P30-S2 read exactly 0 hits, the same count as RC-D's M1 at 531001, under a different key and a different trial stream. Recorded per rule 8 as a repeated null reading of this construction across two keys; two 0-hit readings at ~1-event expectation is unremarkable under the null (P(0) ~ 0.37 each) and no interpretation is attached.

The AES arm excluded 1 trivial swap and the Feistel arm 0 at S2 (cipher-dependent exclusion, ~2^-32 per-trial rate; same pattern as prior batches). Consumed by the exposure-weighted p0 exactly as in RC-D.
boundaries: This is a measurement at one probe geometry (amask=1, smask=1), one armid (1), one NEW seed/key (531002 / 58146703b42fca722bc0ab918cd1409b), one exposure (2^30), one machine, one 16-round murmur3-finalizer Feistel construction. Together with RC-D it covers two keys of this ONE construction; it does not generalize to other Feistel round counts, round functions, non-Feistel PRP families, or geometries.

The optional 2^33 pair did not run (preregistered budget condition not met), so the S2 substitute reading rests on the ~1-event matched exposure; same modest-count power regime as BATCH-009/014/015's matched comparisons, disclosed in the preregistration power note.
The cross-anchor comparison against the frozen 531001 comparator is cross-seed by construction and is labeled non-decision-driving; only the matched S2-vs-S2 comparison drives the outcome.
It does NOT establish that the r=5 excess is real, does not identify a mechanism, and does not support any claim about AES or any cryptographic scheme.

Toy tier only: reduced-round AES-shaped SPN probe geometry, 64-bit-halves toy Feistel oracle, one machine, no crypto-scale, medium-scale, affected-scheme, or asymptotic claim made or implied. No comparison to published cryptanalysis in either direction.

Session and implementation independence only, no model independence: this task resolves to one model under standing basis 0137a051eb5828789eb267fa83c8278086578d4c. Nothing here counts toward a closure quorum.
